title: Home Oxygen Therapy Setup Date and Payment-Period Start
content:
# Setup Date and Payment-Period Start — Home Oxygen Therapy

The setup day of a Home Oxygen Therapy system is the date of the initial-setup delivery in the patient's oxygen service history. The setup day is recorded as both the setup date and the first day of the payment period, and it is written as YYYY-MM-DD.

## What is read and what is written

| Read from | Item | Written as |
|---|---|---|
| the patient's oxygen service history | the date of the initial-setup delivery | the setup date |
| the same date | — | the first day of the payment period |

The two recorded dates are always the same day, and the format is the four-digit year, the two-digit month and the two-digit day, joined by hyphens.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

The oxygen service history of a hypothetical patient shows an initial-setup delivery dated 14 May 2025.

1. The setup day is the date of the initial-setup delivery: 14 May 2025.
2. The setup date recorded is 2025-05-14.
3. The first day of the payment period recorded is 2025-05-14.

The first equipment month of the payment period then begins on 14 May 2025.

## Questions answered

**Can the setup date and the payment-period start differ?** No. The setup day is recorded as both.
